Our Story

St. Wilfreds has its campus in Jaipur, the capital city of Rajasthan and the famous tourist and business city in north-western India. The Wilfreds campus combines unique classical architecture and thoughtful layout and landscaping to create a perfect learning ecosystem.

Prime Location

The campus is located around the prime industrial and institutional hub of Jaipur and is well connected with all parts of the city. This strategic positioning ensures our students have access to industry opportunities and cultural experiences that enrich their educational journey.

Connected Campus

Seamlessly integrated with Jaipur's industrial and institutional ecosystem, providing unparalleled access to real-world learning opportunities.

Research-Driven Innovation

St. Wilfreds is driven by the spirit of innovation-led research. This is spelt out in infrastructure as well as practices. The multifaceted research encompasses subject-specific exploration as well as the contexts of the business environment in which our students will operate and perform.

Research Excellence

Strong research culture and close industry linkages that prepare students for real-world challenges and opportunities in their chosen fields.

Our Mission

Wilfreds aims at creating valuable resources for industry and society through its interventions in creation of research and innovative culture, academic and professional enhancement and cultural enrichment.

Programs Offered

The College offers a wide array of Undergraduate (UG) and Postgraduate (PG) programmes, designed to foster academic excellence across diverse disciplines. The curriculum is designed in alignment with the NEP 2020 guidelines, under the academic framework of the University of Rajasthan. At the UG level, the college offers B.A. (English, Hindi, Economics, History, Political Science, Public Administration, Sociology, Geography, Psychology, and Music), B.Sc. (Botany, Zoology, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Geology, Statistics, Psychology, and Geography), B.Com. (A.B.St., E.A.F.M., B.Adm.) and professional courses such as BBA, and BCA .

At the postgraduate level, the college provides M.A. (English, Economics, History, Political Science, Public Administration, Sociology, Geography, and Psychology), M.Sc. (Botany, Zoology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Geology, Environmental Science, Geography, and Psychology), M.Com. (A.B.St., E.A.F.M., B.Adm.), MHRM, and MJMC.

B.Sc

Overview

St. Wilfred's PG College, Jaipur offers a rigorous Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) program affiliated with the University of Rajasthan. This 3-year undergraduate course is designed for students with a strong interest in natural sciences, mathematics, and applied sciences.

The B.Sc program at St. Wilfred's provides students with a solid grounding in scientific theory complemented by hands-on laboratory training. B.A. Programme

Bachelor of Arts — University of Rajasthan

📋 Eligibility Criteria

Academic Qualification

Candidates seeking admission to the B.A. programme at Wilfred's PG Autonomous College must have successfully completed the Senior Secondary (10+2) examination or its equivalent from a recognized board of education. The qualifying examination must have been conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE), or any other board. Students from the science, commerce, and humanities streams at the 10+2 level are all eligible to apply for the B.A. programme, making it an inclusive and accessible option for a wide range of applicants.

Minimum Marks Requirement

The minimum aggregate marks required for admission to the B.A. programme generally stand at 45% for the General category (CBSE, RBSE, NIOS) and 60% marks for Other Boards. For candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) categories, the minimum requirement is 42% aggregate, as per the reservation policy of the Government of Rajasthan.

Eligibility Criteria at a Glance

  Parameter                   Requirement
  --------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------
  Qualifying Exam             10+2 (Senior Secondary) or equivalent from a recognized board
  Eligible Streams            Science, Commerce, and Humanities
  Minimum Marks (General)     45% aggregate
  Minimum Marks (SC/ST/OBC)   42% aggregate

📚 Course Structure

Programme Duration and Pattern

The B.A. programme is a three-year undergraduate degree programme. Wilfreds College follows the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) as per UGC guidelines (NEP), under which the programme is structured into six semesters. Each academic year comprises two semesters, with examinations conducted at the end of each semester.

🎓 Programme Duration

3 Years | 6 Semesters

🏛️ Political Science

Political Science is one of the most sought-after subjects in the B.A. programme at Wilfreds PG College Autonomous. The core courses cover a wide spectrum of topics including Indian Political System, Comparative Politics, International Relations, Political Theory, Public Administration, Indian Political Thought, Western Political Thought, and Governance and Public Policy. Students gain a thorough understanding of the functioning of democratic institutions, the dynamics of global politics, the evolution of political ideas, and the frameworks of governance at the national and international levels. The syllabus emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical applications, preparing students for careers in civil services, journalism, law, and academia.

📜 History

The History discipline within the B.A. programme offers an in-depth exploration of Indian history from ancient to modern times, complemented by the study of world history and historiography. Core courses include Ancient India, Medieval India, Modern India, History of the Modern World, Historiography, and Regional History with a special focus on Rajasthan. Students develop strong analytical and interpretive skills as they engage with primary and secondary sources, learn to critically evaluate historical narratives, and understand the complex interplay of social, economic, political, and cultural forces that have shaped civilizations across time. The study of history also cultivates a sense of heritage and identity, which is particularly relevant in the context of Rajasthan's rich historical legacy.

💰 Economics

Economics as a core subject equips students with the tools and techniques necessary for understanding the functioning of economies at the micro and macro levels. The core curriculum encompasses Microeconomic Theory, Macroeconomic Theory, Indian Economy, International Economics, Public Finance, Mathematical Economics, and Statistical Methods in Economics. Students learn to apply economic principles to real-world problems, analyse policy implications, and interpret economic data using quantitative and qualitative methods. The rigorous training in economic theory and applied analysis makes graduates well-suited for careers in banking, finance, policy research, government service, and the corporate sector.

🌍 Geography

The Geography discipline offers courses in Physical Geography, Human Geography, Regional Geography, Cartography, Geomorphology, Climatology, Population Geography, and Environmental Geography. Students are trained in both the theoretical dimensions of geographical science and the practical skills of map-making, spatial analysis, and field surveying. The programme also integrates contemporary themes such as climate change, sustainable development, urbanization, and disaster management, ensuring that students are equipped to address the pressing environmental and spatial challenges of the twenty-first century. Practical work and field visits form an integral part of the curriculum, providing hands-on experience in geographical research methods.

📚 English Literature

English Literature is a popular choice among students who wish to develop advanced proficiency in the English language and a deep appreciation of literary art. The core courses include British Poetry, British Drama, British Novel, Indian Writing in English, American Literature, Literary Criticism and Theory, and Postcolonial Literature. Through close reading, textual analysis, and critical interpretation, students develop sophisticated communication skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to engage with complex texts across genres and periods. The programme fosters creativity, intellectual rigour, and a nuanced understanding of the role of literature in shaping and reflecting human experience.

📖 Hindi Literature

Hindi Literature offers an enriching study of the Hindi language and its vast literary traditions, spanning from medieval devotional poetry to contemporary fiction and criticism. Core courses include Hindi Poetry, Hindi Prose, Hindi Novel, Hindi Drama, History of Hindi Literature, Literary Criticism, and Functional Hindi. The curriculum emphasises both classical and modern texts, enabling students to appreciate the evolution of Hindi literature and its socio-cultural significance. Graduates in Hindi Literature are well-prepared for careers in teaching, journalism, creative writing, translation, and civil services, where strong language skills and literary knowledge are highly valued.

🏢 Public Administration

Public Administration offers these papers - Introduction to Public Administration, Indian Government and Administration, Administrative Theory, State Administration, Comparative and Personnel Administration, and Local Governance collectively provide a comprehensive understanding of the principles, structures, processes, and practices of public administration. These courses equip students with knowledge of administrative theories, governmental institutions, policy-making, public personnel management, state administration, comparative administrative systems, and local self-governance. The programme develops analytical, managerial, and decision-making skills required for understanding governance and public service delivery. It also enhances awareness of democratic institutions, administrative reforms, decentralization, and citizen-centric governance, thereby preparing students for higher studies, competitive examinations, public service careers, and various administrative and developmental sectors.

👥 Sociology

The B.A. Sociology programme develops a scientific understanding of society, social institutions, culture, and human behaviour. The papers cover Indian society, rural and urban life, tribal communities, sociological theories, social change, gender issues, research methods, and population studies. The programme enhances analytical, research, communication, and problem-solving skills, enabling students to understand contemporary social challenges and development processes. It provides a strong foundation for higher studies such as M.A., NET, SET, and research. Graduates can pursue careers in teaching, social work, NGOs, public administration, rural development, community welfare, policy analysis, and various government and private-sector organizations.

⚡ Ability Enhancement and Skill Enhancement Courses

Ability Enhancement Compulsory Courses (AECC):

The CBCS framework mandates the inclusion of Ability Enhancement Compulsory Courses (AECC) as integral components of the B.A. curriculum. The AECC courses are designed to develop competencies that are essential for all graduates, regardless of their discipline. These typically include Environmental Science and English/Hindi Communication Skills. The objective of AECC courses is to ensure that every student acquires a basic understanding of environmental issues and achieves functional proficiency in communication, which are indispensable skills in both academic and professional contexts.

Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC):

Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC) are value-based and practical-oriented courses that aim to equip students with job-ready skills and applied knowledge. Examples of SEC courses offered under the B.A. programme at Wilfreds College include:

Computer Applications Digital Literacy E-Governance Translation Skills Tourism & Heritage Management Entrepreneurship Development

These courses provide students with hands-on training and exposure to real-world applications, thereby bridging the gap between theoretical learning and practical competence. The inclusion of SEC courses reflects the University's commitment to producing graduates who are not only academically proficient but also employable and socially responsible.

B.Com

Overview

St. Wilfred's PG College offers a dynamic Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) program affiliated with the University of Rajasthan. This 3-year undergraduate degree is ideal for students who aspire to build careers in finance, accounting, banking, and the business world.

The B.Com curriculum at St. Wilfred's is structured to provide students with in-depth knowledge of accounting principles, financial management, business law, taxation, and economics. With a focus on both theoretical understanding and practical application, students graduate with the skills required to excel in India's growing commercial sector.

Backed by NAAC A Grade accreditation and recognition by India Today, Outlook, and The Week, our college provides an exceptional academic environment with experienced commerce faculty, industry visits, and placement support. B.Com graduates from St. Wilfred's pursue careers as accountants, financial analysts, tax consultants, bankers, and entrepreneurs, or go on to higher studies like M.Com, MBA, CA, and CS.

Eligibility & Duration

Eligibility: 12th Pass

Duration: 3 years

Courses

- A.B.S.T
- E.A.F.M
- Business Administration

Programs Offered

The College offers a wide array of Undergraduate (UG) and Postgraduate (PG) programmes, designed to foster academic excellence across diverse disciplines. The curriculum is designed in alignment with the NEP 2020 guidelines, under the academic framework of the University of Rajasthan. At the UG level, the college offers B.A. (English, Hindi, Economics, History, Political Science, Public Administration, Sociology, Geography, Psychology, and Music), B.Sc. (Botany, Zoology, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Geology, Statistics, Psychology, and Geography), B.Com. (A.B.St., E.A.F.M., B.Adm.) and professional courses such as BBA, and BCA .

At the postgraduate level, the college provides M.A. (English, Economics, History, Political Science, Public Administration, Sociology, Geography, and Psychology), M.Sc. (Botany, Zoology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Geology, Environmental Science, Geography, and Psychology), M.Com. (A.B.St., E.A.F.M., B.Adm.), MHRM, and MJMC.

ABOUT

OUR LEGACY

The institution has not just kept pace with the changing world, but has been the pioneering spirit behind many innovations in the field of education. We offer strategic values addition to all students by equipping them with different skill sets required by today’s highly competitive world. 

St. Wilfred’s College for Girls  is one of the top colleges and has been ranked 16th among all the national  colleges of the country by the popular and most trusted magazine India Today. Our college has been ranked among the top 200 colleges in under NIRF ranking of Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India and is a recipient of Educational Excellence Award. 

[]

Vision & Mission

Vision

- To nurture and create dynamic and charismatic women who are equipped to be world citizens.
- To make students academically superior and ethically strong to serve the society better.
- To provide quality education through a combination of knowledge & skills to promote a modern outlook with a scientific attitude.
- To instill optimism and positivity in students to promote global competence.
- To instill in students a spirit of responsibility, ethics, and a strong belief in social accountability.

[Top BCA College in Jaipur]

Mission

1. To nurture our intellectual capital through a perfect blend of the traditional as well as contemporary ways & means, for the comprehensive development of the society.

2. To provide a conducive environment for proper harnessing of latent talents of students & encourage them to take initiatives for the development of their personality.

3. To sensitize learners towards inclusive social concerns, human rights, gender and environmental issues.

4. Educating students in accordance with their morals and values.

5. Fostering a sustainable educational environment.

6. Developing brains that are both intellectual and imaginative.

7. Providing an education that is of good quality, while also keeping costs low and being easily accessible.

8. The expansion of information through participation in international education.

9. To provide education in such a manner where the girl child can independently face matters of economy, scientific, and social status.

 

The Secretary Desk

St. Wilfred’s College for Girls   is indeed an oasis of peace and tranquility, providing a conductive, collaborative and supportive environment for teaching and learning. It has enviable features such as excellent infrastructure, labs that answer the most modern demands, a library at par with the best and a magnificent exquisite and aesthetically pleasing auditorium.

 Energized academic and exciting co-curricular activities help student develop a wholesome and integrated personality; inculcate in them the right attitude and a burning desire to excel; cultivate scientific and rational outlook, shunning superstitious belief; develop broadmindedness, inclusiveness, empathy, justice, honesty and creativity and foster personal, social, ethical aesthetic and spiritual values.

Inspiring leadership and richly qualified, caring teachers build productive  relationships with students guide and help them nurture their dreams and fulfill them.  SWCG aims at imparting Total Quality Education. Those who enter its hallowed portals and spend a few years, earn a lifetime of success.

[]

DR. KESHAV BADAYA

Chairman Message

At St. Wilfred’s College we aim at providing education along with holistic development of the students. We are enabling students to grow up to be analytical, investigative, inquisitive, and introspective and task oriented giving experiential learning.

We strongly believe that women possess unlimited potential and with the right education and encouragement, they can move mountains Our vision is based on hard work, open communication, a strong emphasis on team work and a high level of responsibility. This visionary culture allows and emphasizes our students not only to adopt the present-day challenges but also individual responsibilities to the society and our nation at large.

The College is built with the objective of nurturing excellence in every woman through an experienced faculty, world class infrastructure at the campus which is set in beautiful and secure environment.

[Chairman]

Sh. Suresh Kumar Gupta

Principal Message

 

Greetings from the Principal, St. Wilfred’s College for Girls (SWCG).

“We need women who are strong yet gentle, so educated yet can be humble, so fierce but can still be compassionate, so passionate yet can be rational, and so disciplined yet they can be free.”

With this great ideology of giving thrust to women’s higher education, ‘St. Wilfred’s College for Girls’ was born. Since its inception, the college is providing a unique opportunity to young women for quality higher education and is working to build a new society in which women would enjoy equal opportunity with men in professional and public fields. The college continues to be the most sought-after destination for undergraduate and postgraduate studies and attracts students from states other than Rajasthan also.

[WhatsApp Image 2026-03-19 at 15.28.26]

Prof. Manisha Sharma

Wilfred’s College for Girls has continually re-invented itself in terms of academic programs. The college has taken several initiatives in restructuring and strengthening its academic programs at undergraduate and postgraduate levels over the past few years. Mentoring remains the cornerstone of the teaching – learning experience. Pedagogical tools of flipped classrooms, immersion learning, field studies and application-based research are interwoven in an interdisciplinary sense throughout the educational curriculum. With the emphasis on research, collaborative learning and internships with higher learning institutions, corporates and industry, the students find their classrooms full of windows of opportunities.

Students are exposed to challenging and rigorous academics and a host of sport, cultural and organizational activities in the vibrant campus of the college. The college encourages interaction with other colleges and educational organizations across the city, actively engaging women in all its extramural activities and competing with the best on equal terms. 

I am pleased to state that St. Wilfred’s College for Girls continues to be one of the topcolleges and has been ranked 16 th among all the national  colleges of the country by the popular and most trusted magazine India Today. Our college has been ranked among the top 200 colleges in under NIRF ranking of Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India and is a recipient of Educational Excellence Award.

Greetings from the Principal, St. Wilfred’s College for Girls (SWCG).

“We need women who are strong yet gentle, so educated yet can be humble, so fierce but can still be compassionate, so passionate yet can be rational, and so disciplined yet they can be free.”

With this great ideology of giving thrust to women’s higher education, ‘St. Wilfred’s College for Girls’ was born.
